title: Digital health care in oncology
summary:
This study consists of an umbrella study and four sub-projects. 
The goal of the umbrella study is to investigate if patients with malignant tumours adopt digital help and informationen services as part of their medical care. Based on this outcome, individual, app-based services could be implemented to support the provision of care at the clinic.
conditions: All malignant diseases of the participating oncology departments (e.g. urological malignant neoplasms, neoplasms of the digestive system and respiratory tract, hematopoietic system and nervous system)

interventions.name: Survey of people with a malignant tumor or inflammatory rheumatic diseases with questionnaires on privat situation regarding living environment and subjectively perceived condition; repetition quarterly if possible

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Malignant tumour, including gliomas grade 2-4
-Patient age ≥ 18 and able to give informed consent after signing the consent form
-Current outpatient or inpatient treatment or follow-up treatment at one of the participating sites of the University Hospital of the Ruhr-University Bochum (Marien Hospital Herne, Knappschaftskrankenhaus Bochum or St. Josef Hospital Bochum)
Exclusion criteria:
Failure to meet the inclusion criteria
